messages:
maya: Starting deploy for svc-fanout v2 -> rolling 30% now. Can someone own SLO checks for this window? Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/abc123/svc-fanout

deploy-bot: Deploy started: svc-fanout@v2 -> stage: rollout -> traffic: 30% -> canary id: canary-20260321-01

liam: I'll watch p95 and 5xx. ping me if error rate >0.5% or p95 >200ms

slo-bot: Alert rule primaries: svc-fanout 5xx_rate >0.5% for 5m; p95 latency >200ms for 5m

noah: quick check: running synthetic against canary
noah: `heycurl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}" "https://canary.svc-fanout.internal/api/ping"`
noah: first sample: 200 0.15

olivia: saw a small spike in downstream svc-catalog 502s at 12:42; sample traces show retries from fanout->catalog

liam: pulling traces -> https://jaeger.redwood/trace/xyz
liam: p95 now 180ms, 5xx moving 0.35% and trending up

maya: good notes. If 5xx hits 0.7% or p95 >250ms for 10m we pin back to v1 and rollforward blocked

liam: setting alert watch, will post every 5m snapshot

deploy-bot: Traffic shift -> 50% at 1769999992

slo-bot: SLO snapshot 12:45 -> p95:210ms, 5xx:0.72% :rotating_light:

olivia: hm that's over threshold. I vote pause and rollback to v1. Ops runbook says pin/rollback if sustained >0.7% for 2 samples

noah: agree, traces show catalog errors correlate. I'm putting a temp fix on retries (backoff) to reduce burst

liam: holding traffic. triggering rollback: `deploy rollback svc-fanout v1 --reason "canary 5xx spike"`

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by liam -> status: in_progress

olivia: posting quick repro and notes in release-notes thread. Also creating postmortem ticket #INC-4032

maya: thanks. after rollback, let's run a targeted load test against svc-catalog and re-validate before retrying v2.

noah: +1, will coordinate with infra to scale catalog read replicas if needed

liam: final status: rollback complete at 1769999995; traffic at 100% v1. I'll follow up with graphs in 10m

maya: :thumbsup: good call everyone. Adding note to changelog: paused v2 rollout pending catalog fix.

slo-bot: Closing alert run: incident flagged -> queued for triage. errorbudget burn: 0.02% additional

deploy-bot: Deploy marked rollback-complete. Canary canary-20260321-01 archived.
